plan.notes: Source: official Northeastern University Academic Catalog (live catalog, 2026-2027 edition per the Office of the University Registrar, registrar.northeastern.edu/article/2026-2027-catalog-and-course-descriptions/), program page 'Computer Science, BSCS (Boston)', Khoury College of Computer Sciences. Source URL: https://catalog.northeastern.edu/undergraduate/computer-information-science/computer-science/bscs/ (same content as the page PDF bscs.pdf). Program intro: 'The Bachelor of Science in Computer Science focuses on the fundamentals of program design, software development, computer organization, systems and networks, theories of computation, principles of languages, and advanced algorithms and data.' Transcription method: manual transcription of the catalog's official 'Sample Plan of Study: Four Years, Two Coops in Spring/Summer First Half' (Total Hours: 135). Caveats: (1) The catalog presents each year as Fall / Spring / Summer 1 / Summer 2; Summer 1 and Summer 2 half-terms are merged here into a single 'Summer Year N' term, giving 11 terms total. (2) Plan lines that pair a course with its co-requisite lab/seminar (CS 1800 and CS 1802; CS 2000 and CS 2001; CS 2100 and CS 2101; CS 3100 and CS 3101; EECE 2310 and EECE 2311) are recorded as one slot under the parent course code with the plan's combined semester hours; the co-requisite is taken in the same term per the catalog. (3) The catalog plan does not list per-course prerequisites, so every prereq array is empty; no prerequisites were invented. (4) The catalog's program requirement is 133 total semester hours; the transcribed official sample plan totals 135 hours, which is used as total_credits. (5) A second official sample plan ('Four Years, Two Coops in Summer Second Half/Fall', also 135 hours) appears in the same catalog PDF and is not transcribed here. (6) Student-choice slots use choice:true with placeholder codes and descriptive titles; the catalog's official option lists are given in options/choice_note. (7) Co-op terms are 0-semester-hour required entries (required_zero:true) shown in the official plan.
